item.title: Janet Hopper named February Teacher of the Month
item.description: Janet Hopper, a third-grade teacher at Horace Mann Elementary, has been selected as the News-Star’s February Teacher of the Month, an award sponsored by the News-Star and the Citizen Potawatomi Nation.

item.title: Avedis highlights work in 2025
item.description: Avedis Foundation just wrapped up another year of support throughout the community; below are some highlights of the work the foundation has achieved over the past year, including 2025 grants, initiatives and awards.

item.title: Two Bethel girls qualify for state wrestling tournament
item.description: WEATHERFORD – Bethel High School freshman Sicilie Lomeli and sophomore Emzley Miller qualified for the Class 5A Girls’ State Wrestling Tournament after placing high at regionals on Tuesday.

item.title: Shawnee Parks and Recreation
item.description: Hey there Shawnee! Did you know the Shawnee Parks and Recreation Department continually recruits volunteers and interns of all ages to assist with a variety of programs, projects, and events? Read on to learn more! The Shawnee Recreation Center, formerly known as the Senior Center, is located at 401 N. Bell.

item.title: SSC National Champs reunited after 50 years
item.description: Members of the 1976 Seminole Junior College Belles, the NJCAA women’s basketball national champions, are recognized at halftime of SSC’s game against Northern Oklahoma College-Tonkawa on Feb. 16 at the Raymond Harber Field House as part of a 50th anniversary celebration..

item.title: Local author releases Part Three of book series
item.description: Evansbrook: An Ozark Tale of Loss and Dissolution, of Love and Renewal, Part Three: To Gain, To Learn, written by Shawnee-area author Larry Inman, is now available on Amazon.
